adequacy_evidence.quote: **Scientific adequacy: supported.** The conclusion of no convincing whole-brain-corrected vmPFC support is adequately supported by the supplied group maps and reported analysis. It is a defensible absence-of-positive-finding conclusion, not proof of a zero effect.

hypothesis_conclusion.quote: In the 54-person equal-indifference group, the supplied gain-effect estimates do **not** support a positive vmPFC response to increasing potential gain at the whole-brain family-wise error (FWE) corrected level.
